roster_alignment_report.notes: Modeled uncertainty calibration, not measured NBA ratings or guaranteed development.

imported_skill_report.notes: Modeled, bounded skill priors, not measured ratings. No overall floor or career migration.

rotation_profile_report.notes: Reduce a contradictory ranking prior, not invent NBA skills or guarantee a roster role.

sources.title: NBA.com official team rosters, October 13 2026
sources.notes: Official NBA team roster pages provide current team identity, age, birthdate, position, height, weight, experience, and acquisition context. Existing engine ratings remain unchanged.

sources.title: NBA.com official 2026 NBA Draft results
sources.notes: Official completed 2026 draft order and transaction text.

sources.title: NBA.com 2026 offseason deals by team
sources.notes: Officially announced 2026 trades, signings, extensions, and waivers cross-check the team-page roster snapshot. Reported or on-hold moves are not treated as completed.

sources.title: NBA.com 2026 offseason trade tracker
sources.notes: Official player and draft-asset trade details through the snapshot date.

sources.title: NBA 2026-27 salary cap, tax, and apron levels
sources.notes: Sets the game baseline to the official $200.428M tax line and $221.686M second apron for 2026-27.

sources.title: Hybrid player skill input 2025-26
sources.notes: Primary raw player corpus. Contains public stat augmentations, roles, physicals, play-type fields, and raw sim eligibility gates.

sources.title: Player stats export
sources.notes: Secondary player stats export used as a future reconciliation source.

sources.title: 2025-26 NBA schedule export
sources.notes: Raw schedule source for future calendar simulation.

sources.title: Real game minutes 2025-26
sources.notes: Real minutes source for replay/validation checks.

sources.title: Previous adjusted gravity profiles
sources.notes: Useful basketball context from an earlier attempt, but not canonical until revalidated.

sources.title: Pre-season team manifestos
sources.notes: Team identity and narrative context converted into structured profiles where available.

sources.title: Basketball-Reference 2026-27 NBA Player Contracts
sources.notes: Public salary table used to populate contract seasons, option markers, team, and guaranteed salary. Contract terms still need deeper CBA/legal review before trade validation.

sources.title: HoopsHype NBA player salaries
sources.notes: Public team salary pages used as a fallback when Basketball-Reference throttles scripted access. They provide salary years, option markers, and two-way markers, but not guaranteed-money detail.

sources.title: NBA.com team info pages
sources.notes: Official NBA.com team pages used for coaching staff groups and background fields such as general manager and head coach.

sources.title: ESPN NBA Coaches - 2026
sources.notes: Public coaches table used to verify head coach names, experience, team, and current season record where ESPN lists a non-vacant coach.

sources.title: Wikipedia list of NBA general managers
sources.notes: Public table used to verify listed general managers. Because Wikipedia is community-maintained, entries remain lower confidence than official team media guides.

sources.title: Basketball-Reference 2025-26 team pages
sources.notes: Public team pages used to verify head coach and top executive names.

sources.title: ESPN 2026 NBA draft team/pick board
sources.notes: Public 2026 draft board used to populate current 2026 pick owner, original-team inference, and trade notes. It does not replace a complete future-pick ledger.

sources.title: Tankathon 2026 NBA Mock Draft
sources.notes: Free public mock board used for 2026 prospect order, physicals, school/class context, and public stat snippets. It is a scouting input, not immutable truth.

sources.title: Rookie Scale 2026 consensus board
sources.notes: Free public consensus board merged into 2026 prospects where names match. It supports rank ranges, physicals, age, and team/class cross-checks.

sources.title: NBA.com 2026 Draft Board
sources.notes: Registered free public draft-board source for corroborating/manual review. Automated v1 prospect rows currently come from Tankathon plus Rookie Scale.

sources.title: Draft generation, scouting, and AI draft model config v1
sources.notes: Deterministic future-class generation, scouting fog, team draft-board, BPA/need, rookie-contract value, and draft-night trade tuning constants.

sources.title: Spotrac NBA Future Draft Picks
sources.notes: Public future-pick reference used to populate 2027-2033 owner-side first- and second-round assets and protection notes.

sources.title: RealGM future draft pick pages
sources.notes: Reviewed all 30 originating-team ledgers. One asset per underlying pick; native comparison/protection terms and simplifications are recorded in normalization_audit.

sources.title: Critical field fallback method v1
sources.notes: Heuristic fallback layer for missing raw critical fields. Each fallback carries value, confidence, method, and notes so future sims can use a value without hiding uncertainty.

sources.title: Trait inference method v1
sources.notes: Transparent proxy model that converts public/raw stats into hidden basketball traits with confidence scores.

sources.title: League-wide subjective player trait ratings, June 20 2026
sources.notes: Human-eye league ratings prior used only as a full-health calibration layer. Values are quantile-mapped into engine trait space, then manual overrides remain authoritative.

sources.title: Manual 2025-26 preseason overrides
sources.notes: Human-authored corrections for the intended 2025-26 preseason universe, including known snapshot facts and explicit ledger uncertainty.

sources.title: Gameplay staff seed v1
sources.notes: Deterministic seed data for fictional game-facing staff slots. These staff are simulation scaffolds, not claims about real NBA org charts.

sources.title: Player health overrides v1
sources.notes: Lightweight star-only health history and startup injury flags for the sandbox health model. Non-stars use generic risk from the model config.

sources.title: Injury and fatigue model config v1
sources.notes: Quota-guided injury severity/body-area ranges and fatigue/recovery tuning constants for 2K-style sandbox health simulation.

sources.title: Monthly development model v1
sources.notes: Trait-level monthly growth/regression model from age, minutes, role, staff, coach development context, current trait level, and health. Player personality is deferred.

sources.title: Front office overrides v1
sources.notes: Team-specific front-office archetype and competence/personality overrides for bounded AI GM decisions.

sources.title: Transaction AI model config v1
sources.notes: Trade valuation, team phase, practical legality, and bounded GM mistake/noise settings for v1 transaction AI.

sources.title: Contract market and negotiation model config v1
sources.notes: Salary comp bands, practical contract guardrails, inferred player priorities, and bounded negotiation behavior for extensions and free agency.

sources.title: ESPN NBA game summary box scores
sources.notes: Game-level player minutes, DNP status, and traditional box score stats used for availability-aware validation replay.

sources.title: ESPN PickCenter odds from NBA game summary endpoint
sources.notes: Provider-neutral moneyline, spread, and total cache from ESPN PickCenter when exposed in game summaries. Missing games are recorded explicitly and never inferred.

sources.title: FantasyData public NBA odds table
sources.notes: Secondary free public odds table used as a gap-filler for game-level consensus spread, moneyline, and total rows where it can be matched to schedule games.

sources.title: FOX Sports NBA prediction/odds articles
sources.notes: Secondary free public odds articles used as a gap-filler for favorite, spread, total, moneyline, and limited points-prop rows where predictable article URLs resolve.

sources.title: Coach reputation source bundle 2025-26
sources.notes: Soft source bundle for 0-5 star coach attributes. Coach effects are intentionally modest and tunable.

sources.title: NBA tracking source registry 2025-26
sources.notes: Reference registry for tracking categories such as touches, drives, speed/distance, passing, shot dashboards, defense, and hustle.

sources.title: Franchise ledger research queue
sources.notes: Contracts, picks, and staff are scaffolded here until each item is researched against public cited sources.

sources.title: October 2026 new-contract corrections
sources.notes: Reported new-deal totals and NBA-confirmed two-way signings replace stale prior-team salary rows. Estimated annual amounts remain explicitly labeled.

sources.title: ESPN NBA athlete profiles and draft metadata
sources.notes: ESPN profile IDs, profile URLs, headshot source URLs, and draft history are stored for local metadata reference. Headshot reuse rights are not cleared; image URLs must not be embedded or redistributed without rights-holder permission.

sources.title: Versioned imported-roster NBA-role calibration
sources.notes: Bounded priors from existing draft conversion and pre-start career evidence. Not measured NBA skill ratings.

sources.title: Team-separated imported contract resolution
sources.notes: Preserved aggregate source and team components; set-off/net unknown.

sources.title: Imported stamina role-bonus arithmetic correction
sources.notes: V6 unreviewed preserved input correction only. No medical profile or existing-career migration.

sources.title: Imported NBA skill evidence and proxy uncertainty calibration
sources.notes: V7 bounded skill-specific checks, never an overall floor. Reviewed profiles, medicals and existing careers are preserved.

sources.title: Demonstrated NBA rotation profile correction
sources.notes: V8 bounded contradictory-ranking and conditioning corrections. Medicals, current rookies and existing careers stay unchanged.

sources.title: Reviewed five-player scouting calibration
sources.notes: Absolute final-stage v11 new-career decisions; existing baselines retained.

sources.title: Versioned skill diversity, role value and career capacity
sources.notes: New-game V4 rules; pre-V4 saves retain legacy conversion, valuation and development.

sources.title: Versioned offensive roles and shot profiles
sources.notes: Identity-checked NBA shot samples and conservative post/roll priors. Screening is a size/skill proxy, not measured screen assists. Existing careers stay pinned.
